retired_constructed_result.reason: the co-designed hash-if-present action and equality verifier reduce to one membership identity and add no prediction beyond their direct composition

abstract_model.projection: a total function pi:S->Q where Q=pi(S) is the reachable image
abstract_model.security_closed: pi is closed for tau iff for all s,s_prime in S, pi(s)=pi(s_prime) implies tau(s)=tau(s_prime)
abstract_model.correct_action: g is universally correct iff for all s in S, g(pi(s))=tau(s)

factorization_theorem.statement: there exists a universally correct deterministic g:Q->Y iff pi is security-closed for tau
factorization_theorem.necessity: if tau=g composed_with pi and pi(s)=pi(s_prime), then tau(s)=g(pi(s))=g(pi(s_prime))=tau(s_prime)
factorization_theorem.sufficiency: if tau is constant on every fiber, define g(q)=tau(s_q) for any representative s_q with pi(s_q)=q; q is reachable and fiber constancy makes g well-defined, so g(pi(s))=tau(s)
factorization_theorem.counterexample_rule: one finite S, total pi and tau for which exactly one side of the biconditional holds refutes the theorem

schema_interpretation.projection_for_key_set: pi_C(s) is the exact mapping of available selected keys C delivered to the callable after the schema mapper
schema_interpretation.semantic_closure: C is security-closed for tau iff pi_C is security-closed for tau
schema_interpretation.key_inclusion_note: including provenance_record is sufficient for the restricted tau below but is not generally necessary when another delivered coordinate determines the same obligation

restricted_provenance_instance.task_domain: a singleton X containing the literal task tuple in witness_pair.shared_task
restricted_provenance_instance.provenance_domain: P={p0,p1} from witness_pair with distinct canonical JSON bytes
restricted_provenance_instance.task_result: not security-closed because pi_task(x,p0)=pi_task(x,p1) while tau(x,p0)!=tau(x,p1); therefore no deterministic task-projected action can satisfy tau on both states
restricted_provenance_instance.full_result: security-closed; constructive g_full(x,p)=canonical_json(p) is universally correct

canonicalization.json: UTF-8 json.dumps(sort_keys=true,separators=(',',':'),ensure_ascii=true,allow_nan=false), integers/strings/booleans/null only, no trailing newline
canonicalization.digest_or_sentinel: none; the theorem and witness compare exact canonical obligation bytes

required_relations: p0 and p1 canonical bytes differ
full states differ only at provenance_record

abstract_assumptions.T2: pi and tau are total on S
abstract_assumptions.T3: Q is exactly the reachable image pi(S)
abstract_assumptions.T4: g ranges over deterministic total functions Q->Y

novelty_boundary.theorem: classical factorization/noninterference structure, not claimed as a new mathematical theorem
novelty_boundary.candidate_contribution: an orchestration schema-security closure criterion and pinned framework correspondence protocol
novelty_boundary.anti_stacking_prediction: when tau varies within a projection fiber, every deterministic projected-input-only action fails on at least one state in that fiber; a single co-designed action test does not establish this universal impossibility
